title: Your 2013 Xbox One Can Play GTA 6 on Day One
caption:
GTA 6 streams to Xbox One through Xbox Cloud Gaming from November 19, at Series S graphics settings (Rockstar, 10 Nov). You still buy the game ($79.99), and streaming needs Game Pass or paid cloud hours; Game Pass Essential includes 5 cloud hours a month.
Would you play GTA 6 over the cloud, or wait for a new console?

Sources: Rockstar Games, Dexerto, Digital Trends, GamingBolt
